profile.listHint: Separate with commas, e.g. IELTS 7, fluent speaking
profile.help: Agents use this profile. For fields you edited, they only suggest changes and never overwrite them.

items.empty: No memories yet. Chat with an agent a few times and it will remember what helps you.
items.deleted: Deleted permanently. It will not be remembered automatically again.

recaps.empty: No recaps yet. They appear after a chat pauses or a Teach me session ends.

manage.unavailable: Memory is turned off by the administrator. You can still view, export and delete what is stored.
manage.rememberOn: On: agents tidy up memory after chats and use it in replies.
manage.rememberOff: Paused: nothing new is remembered and replies do not use memory.
manage.exportHelp: Download a JSON file with your profile, memories, recaps and chat summaries.
manage.noPersonaMemory: No memories belong to a single agent yet.
manage.clearAllHelp: Deletes your profile, memories, recaps and chat summaries. Agents will not remember these again automatically.

errors.invalidProfile: One of the fields is not valid. Please check and save again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
